title_en: The Views of the Author of Jawahir al-Kalam on the Imamate
summary: His Eminence the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari examines the opinions of Shaykh Muhammad Hasan al-Najafi, author of Jawahir al-Kalam, regarding the Imamate.

works: Jawahir al-kalam fi sharh Shara'i' al-islam
